features: Superfast USB 3.1 Interface with UASP Support: The PowerShell Al1 features USB 3.1 connectivity, delivering blazing-fast data transfer speeds up to 5Gbps. With UASP acceleration protocol, it ensures reduced latency and increased performance during large file transfers.

Compact 2.5-Inch SATA Drive with 500GB Capacity: Equipped with a 2.5-inch SATA HDD (supports up to 6TB, 9.5mm thick), the drive offers 500GB of secure storage for daily backups, movies, documents, and games in an ultra-portable form.

Tool-Free Installation & Wide Compatibility: Enjoy hassle-free setup with plug-and-play installation—no tools or drivers required. Fully compatible with Windows, macOS, Linux, and ideal for tablets, laptops, desktops, and mobile devices.

Built-In LED Indicator & Shockproof Design: An integrated LED flashes during read/write activity for status visibility, while the cushioned sponge layer inside the enclosure protects your hard disk against shocks and physical damage.

Reliable Chipset for Stable Performance: Powered by advanced chipsets (JMS578 and RTL9201R), this external HDD ensures high-speed connectivity, stable data transmission, and long-term durability for all-day computing needs.
